global: A vibrant bowl of ramen sits on a dark wooden table. Golden tonkotsu broth, chashu pork, and nori seaweed create a rich, warm scene with delicate textures and soft lighting.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with smooth grain and subtle wear
regions.bowl: White floral bowl with soft petals and slightly textured surface
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth glows golden with fine bubbles and gentle ripples
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth edges and a slightly worn handle
regions.seaweed: Dark nori seaweed curled into thin, crisp edges with a matte finish
regions.meat: Glistening chashu pork with tender, marbled texture and slight sheen
